title: Molecular modeling of ARF6 dysregulation caused by mutations in IQSEC2.
authors: Shokhen, Michael; Walikonis, Randall; Uversky, Vladimir N; Allbeck, Amnon; Zezelic, Camryn; Feldman, Danielle; Levy, Nina S; Levy, Andrew P
one_liner_zh: 该文用RaptorX结构预测与分子动力学模拟，建模IQSEC2突变对Sec7结构域与ARF6结合（PPI）的调控机制，但对象为折叠蛋白而非无序蛋白/相分离，方法为传统物理模拟，机制建模可迁移启发有限。
abstract: IQSEC2 gene mutations are associated with epilepsy, autism, and intellectual disability. The primary function IQSEC2, mediated via its Sec 7 domain, is to act as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor for ARF6. We sought to develop a molecular model, which may explain the aberrant Sec 7 activity on ARF6 of different human IQSEC2 mutations. We integrated experimental data of IQSEC2 mutants with protein structure prediction by the RaptorX server combined with molecular modeling and molecular dynamics simulations. Normally, apocalmodulin (apoCM) binds to IQSEC2 resulting in its N-terminal fragment inhibiting access of its Sec 7 domain to ARF6. An increase in Ca2+ concentration destabilizes the interaction of IQSEC2 with apoCM and removes steric hindrance of Sec 7 binding with ARF6. Mutations at amino acid residue 350 of IQSEC2 result in loss of steric hindrance of Sec 7 binding with ARF6 leading to constitutive activation of ARF6 by Sec 7. On the other hand, a mutation at amino acid residue 359 of IQSEC2 results in constitutive hindrance of Sec 7 binding to ARF6 leading to the loss of the ability of IQSEC2 to activate ARF6. These studies provide a model for dysregulation of IQSEC2 Sec 7 activity by mutant IQSEC2 proteins.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: IQSEC2基因突变与癫痫、自闭症和智力障碍相关。IQSEC2的主要功能，通过其Sec 7结构域介导，是作为ARF6的鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子。我们旨在开发一个分子模型，以解释不同人类IQSEC2突变对ARF6的异常Sec 7活性。我们整合了IQSEC2突变体的实验数据，结合RaptorX服务器的蛋白质结构预测，以及分子建模和分子动力学模拟。正常情况下，脱钙钙调蛋白（apoCM）与IQSEC2结合，导致其N端片段抑制Sec 7结构域对ARF6的访问。Ca2+浓度的增加会 destabilizes IQSEC2与apoCM的相互作用，并消除Sec 7与ARF6结合的空间位阻。IQSEC2第350位氨基酸残基的突变导致Sec 7与ARF6结合的空间位阻丧失，从而引起Sec 7对ARF6的组成性激活。另一方面，IQSEC2第359位氨基酸残基的突变导致Sec 7与ARF6结合的组成性阻碍，导致IQSEC2激活ARF6的能力丧失。这些研究为突变IQSEC2蛋白对IQSEC2 Sec 7活性的失调提供了一个模型。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
